searchText: Ethereum.org has had a PR in to add Typed Transactions to our transactions developer docs. Could one of the lovely experts here have a look 😬 - https://github.com/ethereum/ethereum-org-website/pull/3836 The contributor learned about typed transactions in order to make this PR so there may be some inaccuraries 🙂
